headline: Wardens Sweep Mooring County as Ruin Consumes Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, intense bombardment and demolition have turned the contested front in Weathered Expanse into widespread ruin, reducing six strategic bases to no-man's-land while leaving Colonials with two garrisons and Wardens with just one amid fourteen fresh territorial clashes. To the west, Warden forces achieved full consolidation over Mooring County, securing all twelve strategic positions following three further engagements around Gravekeeper's Holdfast. Along the Nevish Line, the six-to-two Warden distribution remains intact despite a sharp escalation in infantry clashes that claimed nearly a thousand combined casualties over the past two hours. In Callahan's Passage, where Wardens continue to hold all ten strongholds, direct fighting abruptly resurged with over five hundred casualties reported since our previous wire. Meanwhile, the Dead Lands front has ground to a complete standstill following earlier battering, and the island hexes of Kuura Strand and Fishermans Row report zero activity. Elsewhere along the center, Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow logged elevated casualties without altering existing lines.
